method: Three cold Chrome contexts per scenario, local production assets, no network/CPU throttling; desktop 1440×900 and mobile emulation 390×844/deviceScaleFactor 2. Synthetic auth unconfigured; slow-starter adds a 1,500ms delay only to the optional starter payload. Values are local browser measurements, not field Web Vitals.
scope: Focused on first-screen readiness, reduced optional startup work and delayed decorative globe. Other routes retained route-specific chunks; no correctness/auth/account boundaries were removed.
limitations: This local synthetic benchmark does not replace PageSpeed/Lighthouse field data. The broader repository E2E suite is not clean: some pre-existing specs assert a retired account-link/compose-tab selector, and the static QA preview intentionally returns 503 for unmocked APIs; these were recorded separately and not counted as passing.
